headline: Failed House resolution would have required the Ethics Committee to preserve and release its records on its review of former Rep. Matt Gaetz.
what_it_does: This resolution would have directed the House Committee on Ethics to keep and make public the records from its review of alleged misconduct by Matthew Gaetz of Florida while he served in the House. On December 5, 2024, the House voted to set it aside instead of adopting it. No official summary is available, so details beyond the title are unclear.

who_it_affects.how: The committee would have been required to preserve its records on the Gaetz review and release them to the public.

who_it_affects.group: Matthew Gaetz, former Representative from Florida
who_it_affects.how: Records of the committee's review of his alleged conduct while in office would have been made public.
People would have been able to see the committee's records from the review.
